_implementation_notes: CERULEAN AREA — Main city maps covering the political atmosphere and critical choices.
TWO CRITICAL CHOICES implemented via insert_commands:
1. Misty's positional choice (Map 4 EV003 Page 0) — sets Switch 1132 or 1133
and Variable 342. Inserted before the badge reward at start_index 33.
2. Rocket recruiter choice (Map 8 EV016 Page 0 / EV012 Page 1) — sets Switch 1134.
Replaces the original binary Yes/No with a 3-option choice.
NOTE: Blue's dialogue (Map 1) handled in cerulean_blue.json.
NOTE: Event 50/52 (Officer/Petrel quests) have complex multi-page quest logic —
only modifying dialogue, not restructuring quest flow.
NOTE: Bike voucher mechanic (Map 7 EV002) fully preserved.
NOTE: Trade mechanic (Map 5 EV002) fully preserved.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP text box.
